database.stem: After a long and gruesome season, Jeff Willis has been performing ------- better since the playoffs started a week ago.
database.raw_text:
After a long and gruesome season, Jeff Willis has been performing -------
better since the playoffs started a week ago.
(A) significance
(B) significant
(C) significancy
(D) significantly
database.explanation:
横线处需要填入修饰形容词比较级better的副词，因此答案
是(D)significantly(显著地，明显地)。
